subject.title: Telegram: support fail-closed unknown-group handling with optional auto-leave

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in Telegram unknown-group warn/leave policy, and what exact authorization boundary should trigger it?
rationale: The request adds new config and a destructive channel side effect, so automation should not choose the security/product semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve opt-in warn/leave
options.body: Implement Telegram-owned unknown-group action fields with precise classification, docs, focused tests, and live Telegram proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Warn/audit only for now
options.body: Accept only a non-destructive warning or audit path and defer auto-leave until group pairing or security-event design is settled.

options.title: Fold into broader group pairing
options.body: Keep this request parked behind the broader group-pairing design so unknown-group handling, owner notification, and approval flows ship together.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in warn/leave
recommendation.body: Implement Telegram-owned unknown-group action fields with precise classification, docs, focused tests, and live Telegram proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of recent Telegram authorization history and live maintainer action on the paired PR.
